messages:
Sara B.: Anyone in finance see a support ticket — Acme EU (acct: acme-de-78) says invoice INV-2026-153 wasn't generated in EUR and their PO was rejected. They need a local-currency invoice and the PO on file.
Miguel (billing): Looking. Can you paste the invoice id and the account entity?
Sara B.: Invoice INV-2026-153. account_id: acme-de-78, entity: acme-eu-DE (country=DE). Customer uploaded PO #PO-9922 and has po_required=true in portal. Support says our invoice shows USD 1,234.56 and PO was not linked.
BillingBot: System note: Invoice INV-2026-153 created at 2026-02-03T12:04:33Z currency=USD exchange_rate_snapshot not set.
Oliver S.: That smells like entity->currency mapping problem. Last migration to set entity_currency on tenant objects failed for a subset of EU tenants.
Asha - Finance: Also seeing a rounding delta on totals: customer expects EUR 1,084.31 but our USD conversion and back-conversion produced a 0.01 EUR mismatch. If we reissue in EUR we need to credit the USD invoice first.
Miguel (billing): Quick repro steps I used locally: 1) create account with entity=DE and currency unset 2) POST /v1/invoices with amount=1084.31 currency=EUR and po_number=PO-9922 3) system falls back to default_org_currency=USD -> invoice created in USD. Sample cURL: 
```
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.com/v1/invoices \
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
 -d '{"account_id":"acme-de-78","amount":1084.31,"currency":"EUR","po_number":"PO-9922"}'
```
Sara B.: Customer also attempted card payment and got decline_code: issuer_not_allowed — likely BIN/country mismatch. They indicated they prefer a EUR invoice to pay by bank transfer instead.
Miguel (billing): Immediate remediation I propose: 1) create credit note for INV-2026-153 2) reissue new invoice INV-2026-153-R1 in EUR and ensure po_number is linked 3) provide bank transfer instructions to customer 4) record FX rounding adjustment (tolerance 0.02 EUR) and note on the invoice.
Asha - Finance: I approve a manual credit + reissue for this case. Please attach original invoice PDF and the PO before I sign off.
Sara B.: Attached support ticket with PDFs: https://support.redwood.com/ticket/54612 (invoice + PO inside). Customer said they'd accept up to 0.02 EUR difference if we annotate the rounding.
Oliver S.: I'll schedule a one-off migration to set entity_currency for acme-de-78 and run a backfill for invoices where currency != entity_currency for the last 90 days. Miguel, can you add a guard so PO linkage checks account.entity when deciding po_required?
Miguel (billing): Yep — I'll open a PR to add the entity check and unit tests. Also scheduling the ops run for the backfill tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
BillingBot: Escalation created: ESC-2026-89 assigned to Finance & Billing. ETA manual ops 2026-02-04T09:00:00Z.
Asha - Finance: Confirmed. After manual ops we'll reissue the EUR invoice, issue the credit note, and send bank transfer details. I'll log the credit and close the escalation once payment confirmed.
Sara B.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
